text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident PD-77421 fired for service=embed-inference-worker (canary). Alert: 503 rate > 8% over 1m. origin=canary-rollout/job-2026-03-14.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-77421: triggered -> on-call mika. Link: https://pd.example/incidents/PD-77421
mika: acked via PD. I'm on it. which rollout? @jordan is release owner?
jordan: yeah that's my canary, rolling v2.14 -> v2.15. I saw a few flakes in staging earlier but nothing like this.
sam: oncall-eng-sre joining. any customer-facing impact known?
alice: Observability: spike in 503s concentrated on embed route /v1/embeddings, ~1.2% of overall traffic but 18% of canary traffic. Affected pods show OOM followed by SIGSEGV in nv_driver logs.
mika: good data. tagging eng-sre. @eng-sre can we get kernel/gpu traces?
eng-sre: pulling logs. Initial look: GPU driver segfaults on some nodes after new cuda library in v2.15 container. Crash loops 3 nodes in canary pool.
jordan: ok rolling canary back now. Running rollback command.
jordan: ```
kubectl -n inference set image ds/embed-worker embed-worker=redwood/embed-worker:v2.14
kubectl -n inference rollout status ds/embed-worker
```
deploy-bot: rollout started for embed-worker -> target v2.14 (canary rollback) by jordan at 2026-03-14T22:04:12Z
mika: PD: acknowledged, updating customers impacted in incident. ETA for full rollback?
jordan: should be < 3 min to drain new tasks, then scale down. I'll scale canary pool after rollout confirms.
sam: recommendation: cordon suspicious nodes and move traffic; do not redeploy v2.15 until driver debugged.
jordan: cordon command: `kubectl cordon node/gpu-canary-7` (doing now)
jordan: OK nodes cordoned, draining.
alice: metrics: 503 rate back to baseline in region-us-west after first rollback step. Overall platform 95th latency unaffected. Customer impact limited to some background embedding jobs for partner-payouts queue, estimated 0.4% requests failed with retries.
mika: logging incident timeline into pagerduty and ops channel. assigning follow-up to jordan + eng-sre for RCA.
eng-sre: captured coredumps and nv_driver logs at /var/log/gpu-crash-2026-03-14.tar.gz. uploading to secure bucket and shared in private ticket.
jordan: creating rollback PR to block v2.15 until GPU dep pin. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/embed-worker/pulls/289 (WIP)
sam: good. set incident severity to Sev2 -> limited customer impact but service degraded in canary.
mika: leaving PD note: mitigated by rollback, monitoring for 30m. handoff to oncall-eng-sre for post-incident follow-up.
pagerduty-bot: PD-77421 status: acknowledged -> resolved by mika. Resolution note: automated rollback of canary (v2.15 -> v2.14) mitigated 503 spike.
mika: closing thread here — will open postmortem ticket and link runbook for driver compatibility tests. thanks all :thumbsup:
